parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives in `Shared/Analytics/Sources/AnalyticsTesting/MockStructuredAnalytics.swift`, which is a mock/testing fixture (the path contains `AnalyticsTesting` and the type is named `MockStructuredAnalytics.CPUSessionEventProxy+Playback`). Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record carries mock semantics must be treated as a mock-fixture no-action. Lifting the production type `CPUSessionEvent` from `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Analytics/PlaybackAnalytics.swift` into shared code alongside the mock would couple production logic to test/mock infrastructure. The high Jaccard similarity (0.875) is expected and intentional: the mock is designed to mirror the shape of the real type.
